drhp.business: Walchandnagar Industries Limited is a listed heavy engineering and project-execution company incorporated in 1908 and headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra. It operates across core industrial sectors through three business lines - Hi-Tech Manufacturing, Engineering Products and Engineering Services - serving both domestic and overseas/export project markets.
drhp.end_markets: Domestic industrial / core-sector projects|Exports and overseas projects
drhp.expansion: The routed sections of the FY2025-26 annual report do not describe any specific new capex, capacity-addition or expansion project with a commissioning/completion timeline. The Company operates a manufacturing footprint of three factories — Walchandnagar (Dist. Pune, Maharashtra), Satara Road (Dist. Satara, Maharashtra) and Attikolla (Dharwad, Karnataka). Activity described is order-execution driven: order book on hand stood at approximately ₹871.77 crores as on March 31, 2026 (down from ₹908.96 crores a year earlier), and the Company grew its export/overseas-projects franchise sharply, with …

litigation.note: Income-tax appeals before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) for AY 2014-15, 2015-16, 2016-17 and 2018-19 were in progress during FY2025-26; income-tax assessments u/s 143(3) completed up to AY 2025-26.

drhp.one_liner: A 117-year-old ISO 9001-certified heavy engineering and project-execution company with diversified offerings across Hi-Tech Manufacturing, Engineering Products and Engineering Services.

risks.note: Company reported a loss after tax again in FY2025-26 (following a much larger prior-year loss), leading the Board to recommend no dividend; structural inability to turn profitable weighs on solvency and reinvestment capacity.
Interest cost for the year exceeded the operating profit before interest and depreciation, signalling a heavy leverage and debt-servicing strain that consumes operating cash generation.

Orders on hand fell year-on-year (to Rs 871.77 crore from Rs 908.96 crore); as a project-execution / heavy-engineering business, revenue visibility is directly tied to winning new orders, making the book a leading risk indicator.
risks.risk: Declining order book and dependence on fresh order inflow

risks.note: The Company undertakes exports and overseas projects and reports a distinct exchange-currency-fluctuation line, exposing earnings to adverse INR movements on foreign-currency receivables and contracts.
Revenue is concentrated in engineering / project execution, which is inherently order-driven and lumpy, exposing the Company to execution delays, cost overruns and timing-related earnings volatility.

Appeal proceedings before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) remain in progress for assessment years 2014-15, 2015-16, 2016-17 and 2018-19, creating contingent liability and cash-outflow uncertainty.

Paid-up equity capital rose during the year from conversion of preferential fully-convertible warrants and ESOP allotments, diluting existing shareholders and reflecting reliance on equity issuance for capital.
risks.risk: Equity dilution from warrants and ESOPs

ins.layer: Critical component manufacturing & turnkey system integration
ins.thesis: Walchandnagar Industries is executing a "DNA" pivot, reorienting from cyclical heavy-engineering and foundry toward **Defence, Nuclear and Aerospace**: higher-barrier, better-margin, long-gestation national-strategic programs (indigenous defence platforms, nuclear-power components aligned with India's 100 GW-by-2047 target, and space / missile hardware), a YoY-lower order book, so near-term risk-reward is genuinely two-sided.
